ActorTalk: This is supposed to be a rare opportunity to showcase our academy's culture and the spirit of our students—what's the deal with those other two booths?
Well, in order to boost everyone's morale, the instructors decided to have us hold cultural exhibitions at these booths.
So, our Task Force Battle Association decided to bring out all our prized weapons in the hopes of helping everyone rediscover their passion and original purpose through them.
But after I set up my booth, I realized that the other two booths were just some frivolous clubs.
Hmm... you're right, Senior. Diversity is a very important element.
But... regardless, I still believe that everyone at F.O.S. should be elite warriors with hearts of steel.
So combat competence should be more important than arts and military rations research.
